model_description: Same COMPLIANT two-phase raw-operand scratchpad as recurrent_raw (reduce a mod p in-network, then multiply over raw b), fine-tuned to push tier 3. Takes RAW (a,b,p), no a%p/b%p. Answer is the model's own final generated acc. Tiers 1-3 (raw operands to 64 bits, p < 2^16).
training_description: Warm-started from the recurrent_raw checkpoint (tier1 cleared, tier3 ~0.70 held-out), then fine-tuned with (1) tier-3-oversampled band mix [0.15,0.2,2.0] (tier1 is locked, tier2 is small-prime-pool-limited, so capacity goes to tier3 -- the only tier whose 0.90 crossing changes H>90), (2) scheduled sampling (--sched-samp) to attack the rollout drift that caps tier3, (3) a fresh LR cosine at full 20-digit width, no curriculum. RAW operands sampled up to operand_bits (--raw-operands); held-out prime split; answer collapses under weight perturbation; no hand-coded arithmetic. See dev/train_recurrent.py.
